opening.comment: The agent's first turn does not give their own name or the company name, so the opening requirement is not met.

verification.quote: My name as Niamh uh Willems, postcode 2513 aas.
verification.comment: The caller gave full name and postcode, but the agent never explicitly confirmed them before proceeding, though the agent did say 'Yes. Thank Niamh, that matches your count.' which partly confirms the details.

understanding.quote: My toaster um doesn't work. It arrived yesterday.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue (toaster not working on arrival) and asked a follow-up, though the transcript is garbled and the agent's question about the toaster not turning on is reasonable.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I'll refund this full €32.00 to your card, you'll sea it within 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The customer stated the refund; the agent never confirmed or stated any amount or timeline, and no agent statement about eligibility, replacement vs refund, or the photo/return label was made, so the resolution was not accurately handled by the agent.

process_compliance.quote: Customer: Okay. you know Do I knead to sand it back?
process_compliance.comment: For a damaged or faulty item the agent should have asked for a photo before arranging a refund or replacement, and the agent did not do so.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it doesn't work out have the boxs, that's disappointing.
communication.comment: The agent apologised and was polite, though the caller showed no clear frustration, so the apology is appropriate.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else, and the call ended without a proper close.
